email_subject: Application - Communications Intern at IPPF EN
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern position at IPPF EN. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media, and website management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of advancing gender equality and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across search engines. I am proficient in Canva, including video editing, and have experience with social media platforms like Instagram and LinkedIn.

I am passionate about human rights and European affairs, and I am committed to the values of gender equality, non-discrimination, and youth participation. I am a quick learner, organized, and thrive in multicultural environments. I would be thrilled to bring my skills to support IPPF EN's communications activities, including the #AWorldWhere campaign and Countdown 2030 Europe.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Intern position at IPPF EN. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, I am eager to contribute to your mission of advancing gender equality and sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) through impactful communications.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this internship. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I am proficient in Canva, including video editing, and have experience creating social media content for platforms like Instagram and LinkedIn. My work on mirook.com, a personal project, involved implementing structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to adapt to new digital trends.

I am particularly drawn to IPPF EN's work on the Countdown 2030 Europe and Safeguarding Gender Equality projects. My interest in human rights and European affairs, combined with my commitment to gender equality and youth participation, aligns with your organization's values. I am a proactive, quick learner with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. I thrive in multicultural environments and am comfortable working under pressure.

I am eager to support your communications activities, from creating materials and managing social media to contributing to the editorial calendar for the #AWorldWhere campaign. I am also keen to assist with project support, including logistics and reporting.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your team and grow professionally in a mission-driven environment.

Sincerely,
